origin: Built by Muse (AI assistant) on 16 November 2026 at Steven Powell's request for a traveller Find It room: big category buttons (Coffee, Salad, Fitness Center, Hospital, Pharmacy and more), find-me or ZIP/town location, an inline OpenStreetMap with Overpass category search, results sorted by distance, Directions hand-off, a Help section, and a reciprocal link with the Map Room. No upstream original exists; the collection copy is the maintained original.
